resolved_semantic_defects.title: Coherency cleanup commits casualties without controlling-player choice
resolved_semantic_defects.expected: At either player turn end, the controlling player chooses each model to remove until coherency is restored. With two valid alternatives and no choice submitted, no casualty may be committed.
resolved_semantic_defects.actual: Native finite controlling-player casualties, one at a time through lifecycle dispatch; grouped coherency is rechecked after each accepted choice. Physical ownership, no-reaction destruction, mission evidence and valid pending save/fork/replay remain required.
resolved_semantic_defects.native_datasheet: 000004090 Chaos Spawn, two real models; both possible single survivors coherent.
resolved_semantic_defects.controls: Other cleanup checks verify destruction, no destroyed-rule triggers, restoration to coherency and mission physical casualty inventory. Those passing side effects do not excuse missing owner choice.
resolved_semantic_defects.future_fix_scope: Introduce source-authoritative owner casualty decisions at the turn-end cleanup boundary, one model at a time, before mutation. Recheck grouped rules-unit authority and downstream mission/replay consumers in the future fix PR.
resolved_semantic_defects.previous_observation: resolve_end_turn_cleanup_boundary immediately destroys the lexically first native Chaos Spawn and leaves its sibling alive, for either active player. No casualty DecisionRequest/DecisionResult is offered.
